title: CLR/88/2013 of Ravindra Pathak AND OTHERS Vs Anirudh Katoch AND OTHERS

Heard.
(2) This revision is directed against the order
dated 29.08.2013 passed by the trial court (Civil
Judge, Senior Division, Nainital) whereby said
court has disposed of the application 30C.
(3) The present revisionists are defendants No.
3, 4 and 6 in the suit pending before the trial
court. It is admitted by learned counsel for the
revisionists that copy of plaint has been received
by them after the summon received, but the copies
of the documents filed by the plaintiffs are not
supplied to them. The trial court while disposing
of the application of the defendants have
mentioned that the defendants are at liberty to
inspect the documents filed by the other side or

3
may obtain copies thereof, but the filing of
written statement cannot be delayed on that
ground, as there is no such requirement under
Order 7 Rule 14 of the Code of Civil Procedure,
1908.
(4) Since the copy of the plaint is already
supplied to the plaintiffs, as such, there should be
no difficulty in filing the written statement. There
appears no illegality committed by the trial court
in passing the impugned order dated 29.08.2013.
Learned counsel for the revisionists drew attention
of this court to the case of M/s. Sreenivas
Basudev vs. Shri Vineet Kumar Kothari AIR
2007 Gauhati 5, and contended that the
defendants cannot be stopped from filing the
written statement after a period of ninety days,
where he could not filed for the want of supply
of the documents. However, on perusal of said
judgment, it appears that in said case, the court
had directed to supply the copy of the documents
to the defendants before filing the written
statement. In the present case, it is not so. It is
open for the parties to inspect all the documents
filed by the opposite side and obtain copy thereof.

4
What is required under the law is that summons
must be accompanied with the copy of the plaint.
(5) Therefore, there appears no jurisdictional
error or material illegality in the order passed by
the trial court, in fixing 07.10.2013 for filing
written statement and framing of issues.
(6) For the reasons as discussed above, this
revision is dismissed summarily. (Stay Application
No. 9697 of 2013 stands disposed of).
(Prafulla C. Pant, J.)
Dt.10.09.2013
N.P
